name: Yume
source:
An egocentric boy who is blinded by devotion. He has experience as a cosplayer, and is particular about how he presents himself. He is a member of NEW DIMENSION's Special for Princess!. While he firmly believes he knows best how to present himself, he is willing to make any effort necessary if it means Esu can become the ideal idol.

[Translated from [url=https://ensemble-stars.jp/characters/yume]official website[/url]]
